title: Pacific Fusion’s next fusion machine could clear a key hurdle to commercial power | TechCrunch
summary: Pacific Fusion aims to hit net facility gain by 2030, with an eye toward operating a commercial power plant in the mid-2030s. In addition to demonstrating net facility gain, Pacific Fusion’s new campus will also host national security-related experiments involving high-yield fusion.
